1 · Intro

When to use it.

Update a position when it changes: most often its name, and for a reclassification its job code and maybe its assignment category.

Some changes reach the incumbent's assignment automatically once approved. Others don't, so plan a second transaction for those.

Use this whenA position's name, job code, or category changes, such as a reclassification.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Position changes never reach an existing requisition. The requisition keeps the position as it was when submitted.
  • Reclassifications need Compensation's reclass memo before you update the position.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1A reclassification changes the job. What do you enter on the position?

Q2Which of these does NOT flow from the position to the assignment?

HCM Academy job aid · Position Management

Update a position

Use when: A position's name, job code, or category changes, such as a reclassification. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open the position.
  2. Choose Update and enter the effective date.
  3. Pick the action reason that matches the change.
  4. Change the fields that changed.
  5. Attach the reclass memo, add comments, and click Submit.
  6. After approval, update the incumbent's assignment for what didn't flow.

Watch-outs

  • Position changes never reach an existing requisition. The requisition keeps the position as it was when submitted.
  • Reclassifications need Compensation's reclass memo before you update the position.
